author: A smudged hand, partly washed away by rain
pages:
...the old Jarl's gold was never found, because Torsten hid it where no one would look, in the shadow of the stone that shines at night...

...count nine paces from the stone toward the setting sun, then dig beneath the flat rock with the mark of a fish...

...but beware: Torsten trusted no one, and he did not leave his gold unguarded. Remember what happened to his brother...

The rest of the note is too smudged to read. Someone has drawn a very small, very angry-looking skeever in the corner.
